No user-facing changes in this version.  
- Version bump to 1.0.1; no detected file changes from 1.0.0.  
- Behavior and features are unchanged.

Initial release: Career Success Predictor skill

- Provides a structured, behavior-based self-assessment for evaluating career success potential via 10 custom questions.
- Distinguishes between "fit" (core personal/structural factors) and "readiness" (preparation stage), reporting a success probability range and specific next steps.
- Generates a personalized, story-driven evaluation report file (.docx preferred) summarizing key strengths, weaknesses, and actionable advice.
- Handles ambiguous cases and user follow-up with targeted additional questions or external assessment results for refined conclusions.
- Designed for use in any scenario where users seek to evaluate their suitability or likelihood of success in a specific career or job.
